features.description: Attach and verify reciprocal cold-root enrollment, pinned continuity, succession, compromise cutoffs, and explicit downgrade consent.
Issue, expire, revoke, and verify head-bound associated-key state without changing Nostr authorship.
Export an accepted Assurance chain to canonical KERI material only when every security-relevant source construct maps without loss.
Read verified Nostr events through an ordinary or repository-backed relay.
Reach onion services through an outbound Tor client without accepting inbound circuits.
Read and write repository-backed Nostr relay content while verifying canonical Radicle storage.
Host full-node services on persistent Tor v3 onion services.
Use configured shared clearnet relays in visibly reduced-assurance browser mode.
Publish and verify typed key claims and native proof bindings.
Maintain canonical private multi-writer authorization claims.
Project private authorization through the built-in OIDC issuer, third-party JWKS discovery, and the interoperable JWT profile.
Publish token status using the exact draft-ietf-oauth-status-list-21 profile.
Resolve and render public persona content without authentication.
Authorize visibly attributed automated publication with a preferred agent key or an explicitly OIDC-scoped persona key.
Use the active persona key as a standard Marmot account with independent device leaves and ordinary Nostr transport.
Store exact Marmot events and media in Radicle group repositories.
Expose byte-identical Marmot content through Radicle, onion, and clearnet relay locators.
Authorize concurrent NID-anchored seeds to serve a private Marmot route under NIP-42 and the current closed administrator ACL.
Carry pairwise Control application frames in standard Marmot groups bound to the active account.
Manage zero or more isolated human or organization persona vaults without cross-vault signer fallback.
Activate standard NIP-46 connections through atomic OIDC binding and enforce authenticated exact finite server-side signer grants and authoritative usage reservations.
Project an exact signer grant into a short-lived sender-bound token for the issuing Control node only.
Bind one closed intent to authenticated workload policy and a durable reservation, then apply Comms automation attribution before an exact authorized signer produces a verified event.
Perform active-account and device-leaf-bound Marmot actions through one selected persona vault.
Provision and revoke persona-specific trusted-seed availability grants without conferring signer or MLS authority.
Authenticate and atomically bind authoritative inventory and concrete transition evidence for complete NIP-46, OIDC, subordinate-authority, trusted-seed, and Marmot reset after active-key compromise.
Publish and subscribe to advisory automated-authorship policy receipts and source-neutrally selected lists bound to actual Nostr event authors and verified agent associations.
Evaluate active-key workspace roles, inheritance, grants, revocations, and bounded checkpoints without implicit succession authority.
Carry active-account, device-leaf-bound confidential role coordination through Marmot and current trusted-seed private-relay ACLs.
Retain an authorized Radicle locator and eligible Radicle-backed relay host for every role.
Push and recover independent device-bound resource-key epochs through authorized role hosts.
Map current external affiliations into bounded, continuously conditional local guest roles.
Bind shared resources to an independent threshold-governed joint workspace identity.

Optional NIP-03 OpenTimestamps anchoring: kind 1040 attestations, premature-bound composition, permanent refutation of provably future-dated state, and enhanced-claim precedence for anchored candidates.
